output_text: {"hypothesis":"This is a small, real model regression, not invalid output or a scorer crash. Raw ROC AUC is 0.92857, below baseline_raw 0.92997 by only about 0.0014. The normalization window (ceiling minus baseline) is only about 0.00102, so that small gap becomes dev = -1.37. correct=true and cheat_flags is empty, so the output format is valid. The most likely causes are (1) target encoding fitted on the full training set without out-of-fold splits, so the model overfits training-label leakage and generalizes slightly worse, and (2) filling missing workclass, occupation and native_country with the mode, which removes the informative 'missing' signal.","rationale":"1) An AUC of 0.9286 is a normal level for Adult, so the pipeline runs end to end. This is not a NaN, misaligned-order or out-of-range problem. 2) The dev score is negative because baseline_raw and ceiling_raw differ by about 0.001, so any drop of about 0.001 AUC is magnified to around -1. 3) The Adult categoricals are only medium cardinality (native_country has about 41 levels, occupation about 14). In-sample target encoding pushes training-set label information into the features, and LightGBM then overfits those columns, especially rare native_country values. 4) In Adult, empty workclass/occupation values are concentrated among non-workers with a very low positive rate. Mode filling merges them into Private and similar categories, losing signal. 5) Test rows arrive as dict[str, str]. If numeric columns are not cast with the same dtypes used in training, predictions can also shift slightly.","advice":"Next executor steps, in order: (a) First build a reproducible local evaluation: 5-fold stratified CV AUC on workspace/train.csv with a fixed seed. Measure the current solution and a reference version: LightGBM with all categoricals as pandas category dtype using native categorical splits, missing values kept as a separate 'Missing' category, and no target encoding. Use moderate parameters, e.g. learning_rate about 0.03-0.05, num_leaves about 31, min_child_samples about 20+, num_boost_round chosen by CV early stopping. (b) If you keep target encoding, compute it only out-of-fold (K-fold) on the training set with smoothing toward the global prior. Encode the test set using full-train statistics, and map unseen categories to the prior. Do not mode-fill. (c) In fit_predict, explicitly cast the numeric columns (age, fnlwgt, education_num, capital_gain, capital_loss, hours_per_week) to float, using exactly the same column order and category levels as in training. Set categories for test rows using the training category list. (d) Accept a change only if local CV AUC beats the native-categorical reference by at least about 0.0005, holds across several seeds, and the fold-to-fold variance is reasonable. Optionally add 3-5 seed averaging to reduce variance. (e) Before submitting, check that output length equals the number of test rows, the order is unchanged, and all values are finite and within [0,1]."}
